en.sayed-ali-raza: Your girth is loose and you have put it on the wrong way.
Nevertheless you enjoy in-law kinship and also the right to ask,
and since you have asked, listen.
As regards the oppression against us in this matter although we were the highest as regards descent and the strongest in relationship with the Messenger of Allāh.
It was a selfish act over which the hearts of people became greedy, although some people did not care for it.
The Arbiter is Allāh and to Him is the return on the Day of Judgement.
